name: connect-knock-usage
description: /connect knock with no arguments prints the usage line, and the removed /connect contact name redirects to knock/knocks (issue #121).

config.command: bash -lc 'R=$(pwd); H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-connect-knock"; mkdir -p "$H"; mkdir -p "$H/.kollab"; printf "%s" "{\"kollabor\":{\"llm\":{\"active_profile\":\"openai-test\",\"profiles\":{\"openai-test\":{\"provider\":\"openai\",\"model\":\"gpt-5.5\",\"base_url\":\"https://api.openai.com/v1\",\"api_key\":\"sk-test-dummy\",\"supports_tools\":true}}}},\"plugins\":{\"hub\":{\"enabled\":true}}}" > "$H/.kollab/config.json"; ln -sfn "$R/plugins" "$H/plugins"; cd "$H"; HOME="$H" PYTHONPATH="$R" "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --no-daemon'

steps.title: /connect knock with no arguments prints the usage line
the removed contact name redirects to knock/knocks
the removed contact-point name redirects to status

steps.pattern: your contact route is in /connect status
